proposals.title: TO CONSIDER A SHAREHOLDER PROPOSAL REGARDING A POLICY ON CHINA SOURCING
proposals.proponent: Domini Impact Equity Fund (co-filer Vancity Investment Management Canadian Equity Fund)
proposals.topic_summary: Requests Nike adopt a policy to pause sourcing of cotton and other raw materials from China until the U.S. government Business Advisory is lifted or rescinded, citing forced labor risks.
proposals.evidence: The Board of Directors recommends a vote AGAINST the proposal and asks shareholders to read through NIKE's response which follows the shareholder proposal.
